title: Scope
description: The verified request context (master plan section 10): deployment, application, tenant, workspace, principal, roles/scopes and session. Every level is required; there is no default tenant and no wildcard. Mirrors pkg/contracts.Scope.

application_id.description: Identifies the host application the request is bound to.

workspace_id.description: Identifies the workspace inside the tenant.

principal_id.description: Identifies the authenticated human or service principal.

roles.description: The principal's roles as asserted by the host application. At least one.

capability_scopes.description: The capability IDs the context token permits. Exact match; anything not listed is denied. At least one.

session_id.description: Identifies the conversation session. A session cannot change tenant or workspace without a new authenticated context.
